breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. Instead of choosing the correct model (adiabatic tip) as specified in the ground truth, it repeated both conflicting instructions from the original prompt. The generated specification states to 'Use a convective-tip fin formula' while also stating to 'Assume an adiabatic tip condition', which are mutually exclusive and directly repeats the user's error.
